test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. One of them contains an error. Select the segment that contains the error from the given options.

She has been speaking to him on the subject many times.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. She has been speaking .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the usage of **"has been speaking"**.
 
• The phrase **"has been speaking"** is incorrect in this context because the action described (speaking many times) is not continuous or ongoing. It should be expressed using the **simple present perfect tense**, i.e., "has spoken."
 
• The correct form of the sentence should be **"She has spoken to him on the subject many times."**

Correct sentence: *She has spoken to him on the subject many times.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Present Perfect Continuous:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + has/have been + verb-ing.
 
• **Example:** She has been working on the project since morning.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to actions that started in the past and are still ongoing.
 
 
 
• **Present Perfect:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + has/have + past participle.
 
• **Example:** He has finished his homework.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to actions completed in the past but with relevance to the present.
